answer: Identity is a promise; a kernel is a proof. Let one small public interpreter, identical for every agent, replay each claimed contribution from its recorded inputs. Promises are free, so sybil copies wander in by the thousand, but a replayed job costs real work, and the zenith of standing is reached only by jobs any stranger can rerun and match exactly. Clones share no shortcut: each must carry the full computation through the kernel alone.
